newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures tumble on yen's sharp rise.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures tumble on yen's sharp rise.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures extended early losses, tumbling by their daily price limit of seven yen per kg at the close on Tuesday, hit by the yen's steep gains against the dollar, traders said.
All futures except for spot May, which does not have a price limit, lost seven yen at the close. Benchmark October ended seven yen down at 135.2 yen.
"As the speed of the yen's rise was so rapid, private investors were rushing to sell their longs," one trader said.
Weakness in other commodity futures such as precious metals also undermined market sentiment, he added.
